content.user_title: Find Code by Concept with Serena MCP
content.value_statement: Large repositories make concept-based code discovery slow and expensive. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Serena MCP for targeted symbol search.
actual_capabilities: Finds symbols by concept or name using Serena MCP guidance.
Maps references between functions, classes, interfaces, and components.
Suggests overview-first workflows for unfamiliar files.
Combines semantic search with targeted retrieval to reduce token usage.
Provides troubleshooting steps when Serena indexes are stale or incomplete.
limitations: Requires Serena MCP or compatible tools to be available in the workspace.
Less useful for small projects or exact literal searches.
Search quality depends on language server support and current indexes.
It guides discovery workflows; it does not guarantee correct refactors.

use_cases.title: Map Authentication Flow
use_cases.description: Find login, token, and session handling across services without reading every file.

use_cases.title: Plan Multi-File Refactors
use_cases.description: Locate symbols and references before renaming models, services, or components.

use_cases.title: Understand Component Data Paths
use_cases.description: Trace how a component receives data from pages, services, and APIs.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic-code-hunter to find where this project handles user login. Start broad and list the most relevant symbols and files.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic-code-hunter to trace how ProjectCard receives data. Show the source, transformations, and main call path.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic-code-hunter to find every reference to the User model. Group the affected files by risk and required edit type.

prompt_templates.title: Trace Cross-Module Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic-code-hunter to analyze the impact of changing token validation. Include callers, downstream dependencies, and tests to review.

output_examples.input: Find where password reset is handled.
output: Relevant areas include the account service, password reset route, and notification sender.
Recommended next read is the reset token validator and related expiry tests.
Potential impact includes email delivery, token lifetime, and account recovery errors.

output_examples.input: Trace how the dashboard gets project data.
output: The data path starts at the project API, passes through the page loader, and reaches dashboard cards.
The main references show one shared project summary shape used by two components.
Review the loader and card props before changing the data contract.

output_examples.input: Prepare to rename the User model to Account.
output: Primary references appear in authentication, billing, and profile management areas.
High-risk edits involve database access and authorization checks.
Tests should cover login, account settings, and billing ownership flows.

best_practices: Start with broad concept terms, then narrow to specific symbols and references.
Use Serena results to choose targeted file reads before editing.
Fall back to text search when names or literals matter more than relationships.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for tiny projects or one known file.
Renaming symbols before reviewing all references and call paths.
Running indexing commands without user approval in restricted workspaces.

faq.question: Does this skill search code by meaning?
faq.answer: It guides Serena MCP workflows that search symbols and relationships by concept, name, and usage.

faq.question: Do I need Serena MCP installed?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on Serena MCP or equivalent semantic code tools being available.

faq.question: When should I use grep instead?
faq.answer: Use grep for exact text, literal strings, small projects, or known files.

faq.question: Can it perform refactors automatically?
faq.answer: It helps locate affected symbols and references. Actual edits still require review and execution by the agent.

faq.question: Is it useful for architecture reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide discovery of services, components, references, and dependency paths.

faq.question: What happens if Serena returns no results?
faq.answer: The skill recommends broader terms, spelling checks, text search fallback, and confirmed indexing before re-running searches.
